detailLevel: actionable after Feature 1 and Feature 2 learnings
description: Add a humble, non-destructive photo editor accessible from the review grid and lightbox. It supports crop, core adjustments, and presets with a live browser preview, server-side rendering, local edit persistence, thumbnail/lightbox badges, and commit-time upload/stacking into Immich as edited versions. The editor must keep the existing Review -> Rate -> Stack -> Commit workflow fast and visually consistent with the design handoff.
designReference: design/design_handoff_photodesk/lightbox.jsx (Editor, Stage, Histogram), design/design_handoff_photodesk/components.jsx (adjCss, tempOverlay, vignetteOverlay, ADJ_ZERO, PRESETS), design/design_handoff_photodesk/README.md Section 4 (Editor).
principles: Non-destructive: originals are never mutated. Saved edits become local pending versions and upload to Immich as stacked variants only on explicit Commit.
Keep Review language user-facing. Internal code can keep historical cull names when too invasive, but UI copy should say Review/reviewed.
Live preview first: adjustment/crop interactions must feel instant in the browser; server rendering happens on Save.
CSS-to-sharp parity: saved output should closely match preview. Known divergences must be documented and tested with fixtures.
Humble scope: not Lightroom. Exposure/contrast/crop/presets cover common phone-photo fixes without slowing the review flow.
Desktop-first with guarded mobile: optimize the full editor for desktop, but preserve tap access to Save/Cancel/Commit paths at narrow widths and iOS web-app scale.
No visual drift: use the existing dark-only tokens, Hanken Grotesk/JetBrains Mono, blue/green/red semantics, 1px borders, and rounded controls from the shipped app.

schemaPlan.snapshot: Update db/schema.sql in the same commit.
columns: session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
render_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(render_status IN ('pending','rendering','ready','failed','uploaded'))
schemaPlan.storage: Rendered files live under PHOTODESK_EDIT_DIR when set; otherwise a local ignored directory such as ./var/edits. The DB stores paths plus render/upload status for retry safety.

stories.title: Editor entry points and shell
stories.summary: Open the editor from lightbox and from an image card without losing the user's current review context.
acceptanceCriteria: Every kept/reviewed asset can open an editor panel or overlay from the grid/lightbox.
Closing returns to the same scene, selection, stage, filter, and scroll position.
The existing stage header remains usable; editor entry does not hide the path to Commit on narrow screens.
The shell matches shipped typography, borders, dark surface, and control sizing.

stories.title: Adjustment model and always-available rating
stories.summary: Add the adjustment state model while preserving the Feature 2 learning that star rating should always be available, not only in Rate mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Adjustment state starts from ADJ_ZERO and supports exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, temp, saturation, vibrance, and vignette.
Controls use -100..100 except vignette 0..100; reset affordance restores individual sliders to zero.
Star rating remains available in Review/lightbox/editor contexts via taps/clicks and keyboard 1-5.
Saved ratings and edit states are independent: rating changes do not dirty edit state.

stories.title: Live CSS preview and presets
stories.summary: Port the prototype preview engine to vanilla JS with original, punch, warm, cool, matte, black-and-white, and film presets.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview updates without a network roundtrip while sliders or preset pills change.
Preset selection applies a complete adjustment bundle immediately and remains editable afterward.
Temperature/vignette overlays are visually close to the design prototype and do not block pointer interactions.
Original preset restores ADJ_ZERO.

stories.title: Crop UI
stories.summary: Support non-destructive crop with common aspect ratios and a rule-of-thirds overlay.
acceptanceCriteria: Aspect choices include Original, 1:1, 4:5, 5:4, 3:2, 2:3, and 16:9.
The crop overlay is visible against bright/dark photos and follows current design tokens.
Crop coordinates are stored normalized so preview and server rendering are resolution-independent.
On narrow screens, crop handles remain touchable and Save/Cancel remains visible without rotating the device.

stories.title: Server render pipeline
stories.summary: Render saved edits with sharp from the Immich original and persist the output locally for commit/retry.
acceptanceCriteria: A save endpoint fetches the source asset from Immich server-side, renders with sharp, stores the file, and records edit metadata/status.
HEIC/iPhone originals are detected; unsupported libvips/HEIC capability returns a clear app error instead of corrupt output.
Render failure leaves the previous ready edit intact when one exists and records render_error for visibility/retry.
Rendered file writes are atomic: temporary path first, then rename into final location.

stories.title: Edit persistence and badges
stories.summary: Persist edit state per session/asset and show edited state everywhere a user makes review decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Reloading a session restores saved edits, badges, and adjustment/crop values.
Grid cards, lightbox filmstrip, and image stage show a compact EDITED badge using existing blue accent styling.
Changing a saved edit returns status to pending/rendering/ready as appropriate without creating duplicate rows.
Session labels added during Feature 2 remain unchanged by editor state.

stories.title: Commit integration for edited versions
stories.summary: Upload ready edited files to Immich on Commit and stack them with originals without breaking the existing reviewed/processed semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit summary clearly states how many edited versions will upload in addition to reject/rating/stack actions.
Edited upload is opt-in if the design keeps a checkbox, otherwise explicit in the Commit confirmation copy.
Successful edited upload stores immich_asset_id and marks the edit uploaded, making retry idempotent enough to avoid duplicate uploads when possible.
A failed upload does not mark the session committed/processed; the user can retry after fixing the error.
After successful commit, local discovery/library caches are invalidated so newly uploaded edited assets do not appear as unreviewed originals.

stories.title: Visual and mobile resilience
stories.summary: Preserve the desktop design while avoiding the narrow-header failure discovered during Feature 2 manual testing.
acceptanceCriteria: At desktop widths, the editor uses the prototype split layout: preview first, controls in a fixed-width right rail around 320px.
At approximately <=700px, the editor becomes a stacked/fullscreen layout with controls reachable by tabs/drawer and persistent Save/Cancel actions.
Text inputs/selects use mobile-safe sizing where relevant to avoid iOS zoom; taps work without hover assumptions.
Keyboard legend can compress or hide on narrow screens, but primary actions cannot become unreachable.

stories.title: Verification fixtures and documentation
stories.summary: Add repeatable tests for migration, render parity, and commit safety, plus document known sharp/CSS differences.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration tests cover fresh DB, idempotent rerun, and upgrading an existing Feature 2 DB to 003.
Backend tests exercise adjustment JSON validation and reject invalid crop/range values.
A fixture render test compares output dimensions, crop bounds, and deterministic file creation for at least one JPEG.
Manual QA notes include desktop and narrow-width screenshots before the feature is marked shipped.

backendDependencies: sharp npm package for image processing, added only with this feature.
Immich original asset download endpoint already used/proxied server-side; verify exact API shape against current local Immich before coding upload/stack calls.
Immich asset upload endpoint and stack endpoint for final Commit integration.
Configurable PHOTODESK_EDIT_DIR for rendered files; production should prefer a durable path outside volatile tmp.
researchNeeded: sharp equivalents for CSS brightness/contrast/saturate/highlights/shadows and acceptable preview/output tolerances.
Temperature simulation in sharp, likely via tint/overlay/composite rather than a direct API.
Vignette generation through a radial mask/composite.
HEIC support in the installed sharp/libvips build on the deployment host.
Current Immich upload and stacking request/response details against the local Immich version before implementation.
outOfScope: Advanced color grading beyond presets and basic sliders
implementationSlice: Editor recipes and live preview are shipped on the feature branch; sharp rendering and Immich upload/stacking remain.
